text: SDK lets you register a tool/function and automatically manages the call-and-execute loop, detecting the model's expected format
quote: Register a tool and the function that runs it. The SDK owns the call-and-execute loop and detects the format the model expects.

text: generateStructured validates output against a schema and can auto-repair invalid results
quote: `generateStructured` validates the result against a schema and can repair it.

text: Kotlin SDK runs language, speech, and vision models fully on-device, working offline with no data leaving the phone
quote: The RunAnywhere Kotlin SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device. Prompts, audio, and images stay on the phone, and everything keeps working with no network.

text: Server exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint so official OpenAI client libraries work by just changing base_url
quote: The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so the official OpenAI clients work by pointing `base_url` at it.

text: CLI authentication happens via browser sign-in rather than pasting an API key into the terminal
quote: Sign-in happens in the browser. You never paste a Cloud key into the terminal to authenticate.

text: CLI can run a small local model fully offline without needing an account
quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.

text: A single command points a coding tool at a model and starts it with no manual configuration
quote: One command points a tool at a model and starts it. There is nothing to configure by hand

text: SDK supports token-by-token streaming generation via an async event stream
quote: for try await event in try await RunAnywhere.llm.generateStream(prompt: "Write a haiku") { if case .token(let token) = event { print(token.text, terminator: "") } }

text: Detailed download progress reporting (bytes, percent, speed, ETA, retries) for model downloads
quote: `DownloadProgress` carries `bytesDone`, `bytesTotal`, `fraction`, `percent`, `bytesPerSecond`, `etaSeconds`, `retryAttempt`, `currentFileIndex`, `totalFiles`, and `overallProgress`.

text: Local vs. hosted cloud execution is an explicit user choice; the CLI never silently switches between them
quote: Wally handles browser sign-in and keeps hosted execution **explicit**. A request only leaves your machine _when you say so_.

text: CLI commands let users check authentication status and view their cloud usage/spend
quote: Check it with `wally account whoami`, and see what you have spent with `wally account usage`.

text: A single shared C++ core is wrapped by six thin language bindings so behavior is consistent across platforms
quote: One C++ core, six thin bindings. Behaviour that does not drift between platforms.

text: Runtime is private-by-default, works fully offline, and accelerates using whatever silicon the device provides
quote: Private by default. Offline by design. Accelerated by whatever silicon the device has.

text: Cloud tier runs models on RunAnywhere's own hardware so users can access models too large for their local device using the same tools
quote: Cloud models run on RunAnywhere's hardware instead of the user's, so you can use models too large for a laptop while keeping the same tools.

text: SDK supports multi-turn conversations by passing an array of chat messages instead of a single prompt
quote: Pass `[ChatMessage]` instead of a prompt to hold a conversation.

text: A system prompt can be set to define the model's role and constraints for an entire conversation
quote: A system prompt sets the model's role and constraints for the whole exchange.

text: Speech-to-text supports both one-shot transcription of audio input and streaming transcription by pushing live microphone frames
quote: You hold a handle and push frames into it as the microphone produces them.

text: Text-to-speech offers multiple synthesis methods depending on whether raw samples or spoken playback is needed
quote: Three methods, depending on whether you want the samples or just want it spoken.

text: Streaming text-to-speech emits audio chunks as they're generated so playback can start before synthesis finishes
quote: `synthesizeStream` emits `AudioChunk` values as they are produced, so playback can start on the first chunk instead of waiting for the last.

text: Voice activity detection API reports whether someone is currently speaking
quote: `RunAnywhere.vad` answers "is someone talking right now".

text: Built-in voice assistant session combines speech-to-text, an LLM, and text-to-speech so it can listen, think, and answer aloud
quote: `RunAnywhere.voice` assembles speech-to-text, a language model, and text-to-speech into one session that listens, thinks, and answers out loud.

text: Speaker diarization segments an audio recording by who is speaking
quote: Diarization segments a recording by speaker.

text: Vision-language model API takes an image plus a prompt
quote: `RunAnywhere.vlm` takes an image and a prompt.

text: Image generation API produces an image from a text prompt
quote: `RunAnywhere.images` generates an image from a prompt.

text: Full documented integration path for adding on-device LLM, STT, and TTS to a React Native app via the SDK
quote: The complete integration path for adding on-device LLM, STT, and TTS to a React Native app with the RunAnywhere SDK

text: An agentic kernel pipeline generates, compiles, and validates each compute kernel against the specific silicon it will run on
quote: An agentic kernel pipeline generates, compiles, and **validates every kernel against the silicon it runs on**.

text: NPU-accelerated inference is supported on Qualcomm Hexagon devices, with first benchmarks on Snapdragon hardware
quote: NPU inference for all Qualcomm Hexagon devices. First benchmarks on Snapdragon silicon.
